title: How the models work
whenWrong: How they behave when things go wrong
synthetic: Every training row is synthetic. A script made it. These numbers describe that script. They are not a classroom study.
assumption: Reading-time multipliers are assumptions, not measured values. Timing is divided by them so a longer script is not treated as a slow start.
strokes: Stroke templates are hand-written approximations, not real children's handwriting. Chinese math class uses Western digits, so hanzi numerals are not in the drawing model.
limitGrade: This is a classroom support tool. It is not a grade.
limitDisability: It is not a diagnosis of a learning disability.
limitPrivacy: Drawings stay on the device. The app does not send them anywhere. In individual mode (Learn on my own), the space name, optional PIN, and lesson progress also stay on the device only — nothing is sent to Firebase unless the learner later joins a class.
soloModeBody: Learn on my own keeps progress in on-device storage. There is no email, password, or cloud account. A short placement check can suggest a starting planet; children can still choose another planet and explore.
exploreBody: Explore is an optional, untimed moon-station area with open number-sense activities (ten-frames, subitizing looks, number talks, which-one-does-not-belong, make 10/20/100, number lines, story building, and skip-counting patterns). It celebrates many ways of thinking. It does not add diagnosis codes. Optional coarse signals (activity id, ways found, timestamp) stay on the device with other progress. Design notes cite classroom practices such as number talks and CRA as influences, not endorsements. Not tested with children in this release; not reviewed by educators as a formal study.
